title: Gluten-Free Filipino Sisig
description: A twist on the classic Filipino dish, this sisig recipe uses pork and is gluten-free. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Pork Face
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher to chop the pork face into small pieces.

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork face until browned on all sides. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté the onion until softened.
Add the chili and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vinegar, patis, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Return the pork face to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the sisig to a serving plate and garnish with cilantro and savory.
